# Koadr — marketing site

> Public marketing site for Koadr (https://koadr.dev), a multi-page React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS project. This repository contains the website only; it is not the application itself.

## What this is

A static, client-rendered marketing website with nine routes (home, features, providers, pricing, self-host, changelog, privacy, terms and a 404 page). All copy lives in a single content file. The site is deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

- Live site: https://koadr.dev
- Application (hosted product): https://app.koadr.dev
- Product source code: https://github.com/iliasgnrs/koadr

## Tech

- React 19 + TypeScript, built with Vite
- Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables for light and dark mode
- React Router with lazy-loaded routes
- Self-hosted fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (code)

## Structure

- `src/pages/` — one component per route
- `src/components/` — Navbar, Footer, CTASection, SectionHeading, FeatureCard, CodeBlock, PricingCard, Workbench
- `src/content/site.ts` — all copy, URLs and pricing
- `src/lib/hooks.ts` — theme handling and per-route metadata
- `public/` — favicons, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, Open Graph image

## Commands

- `npm install` — install dependencies
- `npm run dev` — local dev server
- `npm run build` — typecheck and build to `dist/`
- `npm run preview` — serve the production build locally
- `npm run lint` — run oxlint

Deployment is a static upload of `dist/` to Cloudflare Pages. No server runtime is required.

## Licensing and reuse

This is a proprietary marketing site. Do not copy its copy, design or brand assets. The Koadr product itself is MIT licensed; see https://github.com/iliasgnrs/koadr.
